title: Customer renewal call
text:
Maya: Thanks for making time. Your contract renews at the end of next month, so I wanted to check in.
Client: Sure. Overall the team is happy, but we have a few concerns before we sign again.
Maya: Please go ahead.
Client: The main one is the price. Our seat count went up, and the cost grew more than we expected.
Maya: Understood. We can look at a yearly plan, which comes with a lower rate for each seat.
Client: That would help. The second concern is the export. Our finance team needs a monthly export in a format their tools read.
Maya: The new export ships next month and includes the spreadsheet format your team uses.
Client: Good. And the last thing is support response times. Two tickets waited over a day last quarter.
Maya: I am sorry about that. I will check those two tickets and send you what happened.
Client: Thanks. If the price and the export work out, I think we renew.
Maya: I will send a quote for the yearly plan by Friday, with the export date in writing.
Client: Perfect. Send it to me and I will share it with our finance lead.
